watch.summary: After spraying an entire magazine blindly into smoke, the streamer is instantly headshot the moment he stops and starts reloading.

beats.what: Streamer holds an angle outside smoke in Valorant
He sprays his full clip blindly into smoke while yelling
An enemy walks out of the smoke right as his magazine empties
The enemy kills him instantly while he is mid-reload
Streamer throws his hands up and screams in disbelief

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The clip captures classic FPS bad timing where an enemy peeks the exact second the player finishes spraying and starts reloading. His loud, animated outrage immediately pays off the bad luck.
